selection_method: AI editorial selection after reading the current four-perspective introduction and reviewing extracted reading, ladder and atlas terminology; frequency is supporting evidence, not the admission rule.

batch_meanings.1: Introduction and worked-example essentials; draft or improve these first.
batch_meanings.2: Mathematical and physical bridges needed to follow the atlas.
batch_meanings.3: Specialist construction details; write after their prerequisites.

boundaries: Search phrases locate mentions; they are not approved aliases or semantic equivalences.
Compound titles can contain contrasting subtopics that must be distinguished within the explanation.
Current dictionary entries still require contextual review; an existing ID does not certify every proposed sense.
This is a proposed editorial ceiling of 150 concepts, not 150 entries to publish immediately.
Dependency-tag and project-case entries should crosslink foundational explanations rather than repeat them.
